final_topology.title: Secure Government Data Center
final_topology.description: A secure government data center with a DMZ, load-balanced web servers, and segmented production, staging, and management zones.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes a screened DMZ with a WAF and load-balanced web servers. The core application and database servers are in a production zone, while internal firewalls segment the staging and management networks. Redundant connectivity, content filtering, and SIEM integration are provided.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n30) that manages inventory for multiple nodes across different zones, indicating a detailed and maintained asset inventory.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes numerous data flow links (e.g., nl1, nl2, etc.) and zone links (e.g., zl1, zl2, etc.), which indicate documented data flows between various components.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for DMZ (z1), Production (z2), Staging (z3), Management (z4), and Non-Production (z8), indicating proper segmentation based on data sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes internal firewalls (n5, n6, n9) and an application firewall (n26) in the Production zone, indicating firewalls are implemented and managed on servers.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS server (n18) and links (nl4) that configure trusted DNS for the edge router (n13), indicating trusted DNS servers are configured.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an MFA server (n19) and links (nl5) that manage MFA for the management firewall (n11), indicating MFA is required for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS filter (n20) and links (nl6) that apply DNS filtering to the edge router (n13), indicating DNS filtering services are used.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a web proxy (n21) and links (nl7) that enforce URL filtering on the edge router (n13), indicating network-based URL filters are maintained and enforced.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes a well-defined and segmented network architecture with DMZ, production, staging, management, and non-production zones, indicating a secure network architecture.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an IaC tool (n31) that manages various network components, indicating secure management of network infrastructure.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes a central AAA server (n22) and links (nl8) that manage AAA for the management firewall (n11), indicating centralized network AAA.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a VPN gateway (n32) and links (nl60, nl61) that ensure remote devices (n33, n34) connect to the management firewall (n11) via a VPN, indicating remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a NIDS (n23) and links (nl9) that monitor the internal firewall (n5), indicating a network intrusion detection solution is deployed.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes internal firewalls (n5, n6, n9) and links (nl10, nl11) that perform traffic filtering between network segments, indicating traffic filtering is performed.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a network access control (NAC) system (n24) and links (nl10) that manage access control for the internal firewall (n5), indicating access control for remote assets is managed.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a log collector (n35) and links (nl64, nl65, etc.) that collect logs from various network devices, indicating network traffic flow logs are collected.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for Production (z2) and Non-Production (z8), indicating production and non-production systems are separated.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a pen test workstation (n28) and a pen test service (n36) with links (nl79) that provide access for external penetration testing, indicating periodic external penetration tests are performed.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various nodes and zones, but there is no explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit asset inventory system or process is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset inventory system and links to all other nodes to indicate inventory management.

findings_before.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various network devices and security measures, but there is no explicit evidence of secure management practices such as version-controlled IaC or secure network protocols.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of secure management practices is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes representing IaC tools and links to network devices to indicate secure management practices.

findings_before.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an MFA server (n19) and a management link (nl5) to the management firewall (n11), but there is no explicit evidence of a VPN or remote device connections.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of a VPN or remote device connections is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a VPN and links to remote devices to indicate remote access management.

findings_before.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an MFA server (n19) and a management link (nl5) to the management firewall (n11), but there is no explicit evidence of access control for remote assets.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of access control for remote assets is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add nodes representing remote assets and links to the MFA server and management firewall to indicate access control.

findings_before.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a SIEM (n14) and various monitoring links, but there is no explicit evidence of network traffic flow log collection.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of network traffic flow log collection is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a log collector and links to network devices to indicate log collection.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a pen test workstation (n28) and a data flow link (nl14) to the edge router (n13), but there is no explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing service and links to the pen test workstation to indicate periodic testing.
